Identity · 01

Logo System

Three approved forms. The horizontal lockup — ornate D mark beside the tracked wordmark — is standard. Mark alone when the name is already established. Wordmark alone for text-only contexts.

Wordmark spec

Inter 900 · letter-spacing: 0.28em · uppercase. Always weight 900. Minimum size 14px / 10pt. Never recolor, stretch, or set at a different weight.

Clear space & misuse

Minimum clear space = cap-height on all sides. Do not: add drop shadow, place on a busy photo without a dark scrim, use a weight other than 900, or break the wordmark to a second line in display contexts.

Color · 02

Color System

The palette is intentionally neutral. Surfaces are black or bone — never mid-grey. Silver and bone look similar as swatches but serve completely different roles: silver is a type color, bone is a surface color. The only brand hue is A-Team red, used exclusively on A-Team properties.

Black
#0a0a0a
Page bg · primary dark surface

#141414

Silver (type)
#b8b8b8
Body on dark · UI marks · spine
Muted (type)
#444444
Body on light backgrounds
A-Team Red
#A0252B
A-Team pages only — never on DH core

Dark / light section rule

Pages alternate between dark sections (black bg + white/silver type) and light sections (bone bg + black/muted type). Never use a mid-grey background. The section border is always a 1px opacity token — never a solid grey line.

Dark · #0a0a0a
type: silver / white
Light · #f5f5f5
type: muted / black

Opacity divider tokens

--rule rgba(255,255,255,0.08) — hairline on dark
--rule-strong rgba(255,255,255,0.15) — border on dark
--rule-dark rgba(10,10,10,0.10) — hairline on light
--rule-dark-strong rgba(10,10,10,0.18) — border on light

Never hard-code raw rgba. Always reference the token.

Interaction · 06

Spine & Node System

The scroll-driven vertical spine is the primary interactive motif on the Ecosystem section and Manifesto close. A single line draws downward as the user scrolls, lighting each node as it passes. Ghost numerals and the "Be The Exception." headline brighten via CSS sibling selectors — no JS class changes needed for the visual state.

01
Advantage
Node lit · numeral at full stroke · title visible
02
Application
Line reached · node lit · content revealed
03
Association
Line not yet reached · node unlit · content hidden

Spine track

1px · background:var(--rule) · left:20px within .aaa-stack · spans full stack height

Spine fill

Same position. Height set by JS draw() at window.innerHeight × 0.55 relative to stack top. Increase 0.55 to make the line lead ahead of viewport center; decrease to lag.

Node states

Unlit: 9×9px · transparent · border:1px solid var(--silver)
Lit: background:var(--white) · border-color:var(--white) · transform:scale(1.25) · 0.35s ease
Terminus (Be The Exception): 11×11px · same states

Ghost numeral / headline trigger

CSS sibling selector — no JS needed:
.node.lit ~ .ghost-num → stroke brightens to var(--silver)
.node.lit ~ .man-title → color:var(--white), stroke fades to transparent
Body text (.col) reveals via .aaa.in set one-way by JS when line first hits each node.

Web · 07

Web Implementation

Live tokens and performance rules. Reference variables only — never hard-code raw hex in components.

/* ── :root tokens (home.html, careers.html, resources.html …) ── */
:root {
  --black:#0a0a0a; --ink:#141414; --ink-soft:#1c1c1c;
  --white:#ffffff; --bone:#f5f5f5;
  --silver:#b8b8b8; --grey:#888888; --grey-soft:#6a6a6a; --muted:#444444;
  --rule:rgba(255,255,255,0.08); --rule-strong:rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
  --rule-dark:rgba(10,10,10,0.10); --rule-dark-strong:rgba(10,10,10,0.18);
}

Layout

Container max 1380px · 48px side padding desktop · 24px mobile.

Section vertical padding: 120–160px desktop · 80–100px mobile.

Performance

Self-host Inter — no Google Fonts. All imagery in .webp · cover images max 600px wide. Background video via Vimeo background=1. Lazy-load below fold. prefers-reduced-motion honored.

Accessibility

Body text ≥ 4.5:1 contrast. Visible focus states on interactive elements. All images have descriptive alt text. Animations respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

Any page or context referencing "A-Team"

Add whenever the term "A-Team" appears on a page. Never on core DH pages (home / about / resources) where A-Team is not referenced.

--accent: #A0252B; /* A-Team red */
em { font-style: normal; color: var(--accent); } /* color-only emphasis, no italics */
.nobreak { white-space: nowrap; } /* e.g. <em class="nobreak">A-Team</em> */

Type · 08

Emphasis & Word Craft

The DH brand has no brand hue on core pages — emphasis is earned through scale, weight, and contrast alone. A single typographic rule keeps the voice consistent: no italics, ever. The <em> element is used semantically but its italic is overridden.

Rule 1 · No italics

The brand never uses italics. Emphasis comes from size, weight, and uppercase — never font-style. Override the browser default:

em { font-style: normal; }
Rule 2 · Emphasis = scale, not color

On core DH pages, emphasized phrases earn weight through font-size or font-weight — not color. The page has no brand hue. Let scale do the work.

Emphasis mechanics — core DH (no brand color)
The Advisor Behind
The World's Most Driven
Business Builders
Scale + weight 900 = emphasis. No color shift needed.
For 35 years, he has been inside the rooms where elite leaders, industry titans, and market makers reveal how they think, decide, build, scale, and win.
In body: font-weight 700 + color: white = emphasis phrase. No italics.
Rule 3 · .nobreak

Multi-word brand terms must never break across lines:

.nobreak { white-space: nowrap; }
/* Usage: */
<em class="nobreak">Be The Exception</em>.
<em class="nobreak">The Compound Effect</em>
Rule 4 · Punctuation placement

Closing punctuation goes outside the em:

✓  <em>Be The Exception</em>.
✗  <em>Be The Exception.</em>

Exception: quoted exclamations keep punctuation inside.

UI · 09

CTA System

One primary action per page. The hierarchy is strict: a single conversion CTA closes each page or section — never two solid CTAs competing. Ghost CTAs provide low-pressure invitations earlier in the flow.

CTA Hierarchy
Tier 1 · Primary

One per page. Always the page-closing action. Solid black fill. The shimmer variant is used exclusively on the Start Here magnet CTA.

Get The Free Guide →
Tier 2 · Ghost

Used in nav, early-section invitations, and secondary flows. Transparent background. Never competes with the primary CTA on the same view.

Start Here →
Tier 3 · Text link

Nav links, footer links, inline references. Small, tracked, silver on dark. No border. Used when the destination is contextual, not conversion-focused.

Daily Mentoring
Page CTA pattern — how they coexist
Nav
Ghost: "Start Here"
→
Page body
No conversion CTA — content flows
→

Shimmer CTA — one instance, one page

The silver shimmer sweep (rgba(210,210,230,0.32), 4s loop) is used exclusively on the "Get The Free Guide + Audio Series" button on the homepage. Never replicate on other pages or CTAs — it signals the single most important action on the site.

Product Logo System

All DH product logos are white on transparent. They are always placed on dark backgrounds (--black or --ink). Never place on bone, white, or any light surface without a dark scrim behind them.

Usage rule

All product logos are white on transparent. Always place on --black (#0a0a0a) or --ink (#141414). If a light-background context is unavoidable, place a dark panel or scrim behind the logo. Never recolor or place directly on bone or white.

Logo files

All logos are in logos/products/ as .webp. PNG originals available in the DH asset library. Formats: all white on transparent PNG/WebP. Minimum display size varies by logo — check individual logo guide for each product.
